purpose: Bounded diversified acquisition/review queue for the first ~50-stock market-wide research experiment. Membership is a fixed research target, not point-in-time S&P 500 membership.
selection_notes: Retains all 12 instruments in the current reviewed canonical research scope.
Adds large, liquid names across technology, financials, health care, consumer, communications, industrials, staples, energy and utilities to reduce single-sector concentration.
Acquisition does not imply identity review or canonical promotion; those remain separate fail-closed gates.
This target is for exploratory breadth testing only and must not be described as a historical S&P 500 universe.
